player_prompt.intro: Barka da zuwa Frozen Lake! Ana wakilta ku da 'P' a kan grid. Alamomin grid: ' ' = Frozen surface (lafiya don tafiya a kan) ' H ' = Hole (faɗuwa a ciki kuma rasa!) ' G ' = Goal (kai wannan don cin nasara!) ' P ' = Matsayinku na yanzu Ayyukan da ake samu: sama, ƙasa, hagu, dama (ko w, a, s, d) Rubuta aikinku kamar: [up], [down], [left], [right] ko [w], [a], [s], [d] Manufa: Kewaya daga farawa (hagu na sama) zuwa manufa (ƙasan dama) ba tare da faɗuwa cikin ramuka ba !
